domain.name: Creative / Generative Media
domain.description: Tools that generate or remix art, music, video, or 3D scenes — the agent's output *is* the product, not just a means to an action.

governance.name: Quorum / Consensus
governance.description: Multiple parties — agents and/or humans — must agree before an action lands.

pitch: A creative / generative media governed by quorum / consensus, operating at real-time (<100ms) latency.
